messages:
sam_ae: Hey team — need to lock POC success criteria for ACME Healthcare. Sales asks for alignment before we commit resources. Timeline: 6 weeks from kickoff. Targets requested: latency p95 < 200ms, cost per 1k tokens <$0.30, and quality pass rate > 92% on their eval set. cc @alex_se @maya_sre @priya_cto

alex_se: Thanks. Quick q: is the eval set mostly short queries (<=128 tokens) or longer transcripts? That affects kernel selection and batching.

priya_cto: Mostly short queries and a few long contexts (up to 1k tokens) for summaries. We care more about p95 for short queries.

maya_sre: For p95 <200ms we need to run on Dedicated with A10x or similar and prefix caching for repeated prompts. Can we commit to dedicated nodes for POC? :thinking_face: 

sam_ae: ACME is willing to pay for a 6-week Dedicated trial if we provide usage credits. Need pricing estimate — send me ballpark.

devin_ml: For quality, suggest we use their 1500 eval prompts and run 3 models: baseline v1 (open-1.3B), quantized v2, and our recommended performant variant. Acceptance if top model >=92% pass and no regression vs baseline >1.5%.

alex_se: Also define clear latency/cost acceptance thresholds per workload: short query p95 <200ms, long summary p95 <800ms, inference cost per 1k tokens <$0.30 averaged. If any one fails, POC is conditional — we can allow 2-week grace to optimize.

priya_cto: Agreed. Also need data handling: logs must not contain PHI, retention 30 days, must support customer-managed KMS. SOC2 evidence required.

maya_sre: Security blockers: SSO (SAML/SCIM), VPC peering or private endpoints, and KMS for keys. Without SCIM SSO they won't sign. Who owns the questionnaire? @sam_ae

sam_ae: I'll own the security questionnaire. Can someone from Eng provide SOC2 artifacts and an architecture diagram? @devin_ml @alex_se

devin_ml: I'll attach a minimal architecture sketch in the POC repo today and send SOC2 pack via secure share. Also will prepare a small eval harness (curl example) for their 1500 prompts:

`````
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-pegasus","input":"<prompt>"}'
`````

alex_se: Ownership matrix: Sam (sales) owner, Alex (solutions) POC runbook + prompts, Devin (eng-ml) eval harness + model configs, Maya (sre) infra and SSO setup, Priya (customer) will provide eval set + success sign-off.

sam_ae: Timeline checkpoints: Week0 kickoff, Week1 infra ready, Week2 baseline runs, Week4 optimization + cost tuning, Week6 handover + acceptance test. We'll schedule weekly demos on Fridays.

priya_cto: Acceptance criteria recap: 1) Short p95 <200ms, 2) Long p95 <800ms, 3) Quality >=92% pass on eval, 4) Avg cost <=$0.30/1k tokens, 5) Security controls in place. If 1-4 met but 5 outstanding, can we extend to remediate within 2 weeks?

maya_sre: Yes but must be scoped — SSO & KMS need partner approvals; if they need on-prem private deployment that's additional lead time.

sam_ae: Pricing note: Hosted trial would be $X/day estimate; Dedicated trial estimate is $Y/week (includes reserved GPU + support). I'll put numbers in the CRM and share.

alex_se: One more: provide a small set of golden prompts and acceptance scripts. We'll measure exact pass-rate and p95 from our telemetry. Logging and eval thresholds will be automated.

deploy-bot: Deploy started: poc-dedicated-cluster-1719001234 (ETA 18m)

sam_ae: Awesome. Next actions: Sam to send contract addendum for Dedicated trial; Alex to share runbook; Devin to post eval harness link; Maya to start SSO config. Priya to upload eval dataset to secure bucket.

priya_cto: Uploading now. Thanks all :rocket:
